simple.meaning: to descend (literally, to go downwards ; or conventionally to a lower region, as the shore, a boundary, the enemy, etc.; or figuratively, to fall ); causatively, to bring down (in all the above applications)
simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to יָרַד (H3381) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: v.
simple.whyItMatters: This word appears 381 times in the Hebrew Bible, so BibleIQ can compare how Scripture uses it across multiple passages.
simple.summary: יָרַד (yârad) means to descend (literally, to go downwards ; or conventionally to a lower region, as the shore, a boundary, the enemy, etc.; or figuratively, to fall ); causatively, to bring down (in all the above applications) First listed occurrence: 1Chr 7 21.
